panels.title: ⚡ Performance Overview (性能概览)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) as total_calls
FROM llm.ai_brain_calls
WHERE ts_ny >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY

panels.title: 📊 Total Calls (总调用数)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round(avg(duration_ms), 1) as avg_latency_ms
FROM llm.ai_brain_calls
WHERE ts_ny >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY

panels.title: ⏱️ Average Latency (平均延迟)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round(quantile(0.95)(duration_ms), 1) as p95_latency_ms
FROM llm.ai_brain_calls
WHERE ts_ny >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY

panels.title: 📈 P95 Latency (P95 延迟)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round(count(*) / 24.0, 1) as calls_per_hour
FROM llm.ai_brain_calls
WHERE ts_ny >= now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY

panels.title: 🔄 Calls per Hour (每小时调用量)
🚨 Health & Error Monitoring (健康与错误监控)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) as slow_calls
FROM llm.ai_brain_calls
WHERE ts_ny >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
  AND duration_ms > 60000

panels.title: 🐢 Slow Calls >60s (慢调用)

targets.rawSql:
WITH today AS (
    SELECT count(*) as calls_today
    FROM llm.ai_brain_calls
    WHERE toDate(ts_ny) = today()
),
yesterday AS (
    SELECT count(*) as calls_yesterday
    FROM llm.ai_brain_calls
    WHERE toDate(ts_ny) = today() - INTERVAL 1 DAY
)
SELECT
    t.calls_today,
    round((t.calls_today - y.calls_yesterday) * 100.0 / greatest(y.calls_yesterday, 1), 1) as pct_change
FROM today t, yesterday y

panels.title: 📊 Call Rate (vs yesterday) (调用频率变化)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    formatDateTime(max(ts_ny), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S ET') as last_call_time,
    round((now() - max(ts_ny)) / 60, 0) as minutes_ago
FROM llm.ai_brain_calls

panels.title: ⏰ Last Call (最近调用)
📊 Latency Analysis (延迟分析)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    toStartOfHour(ts_ny) as time,
    kind,
    round(avg(duration_ms), 1) as avg_latency_ms
FROM llm.ai_brain_calls
WHERE ts_ny >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
GROUP BY time, kind
ORDER BY time

panels.title: ⏱️ Latency Over Time (延迟时间线)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    kind,
    round(quantile(0.50)(duration_ms), 1) as p50_ms,
    round(quantile(0.95)(duration_ms), 1) as p95_ms,
    round(quantile(0.99)(duration_ms), 1) as p99_ms
FROM llm.ai_brain_calls
WHERE ts_ny >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
GROUP BY kind
ORDER BY p95_ms DESC

panels.title: 📊 Latency Percentiles by Kind (延迟分位数)
🤖 Provider & Model Analysis (提供商和模型分析)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    provider,
    count(*) as calls
FROM llm.ai_brain_calls
WHERE ts_ny >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
  AND provider != ''
GROUP BY provider
ORDER BY calls DESC

panels.title: 🤖 Provider Usage (提供商使用量)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    provider,
    round(avg(duration_ms), 1) as avg_latency_ms,
    round(quantile(0.95)(duration_ms), 1) as p95_latency_ms
FROM llm.ai_brain_calls
WHERE ts_ny >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
  AND provider != ''
GROUP BY provider
ORDER BY avg_latency_ms DESC

panels.title: ⚡ Provider Latency Comparison (提供商延迟对比)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    model,
    provider,
    count(*) as calls,
    round(avg(duration_ms), 1) as avg_latency_ms,
    round(quantile(0.95)(duration_ms), 1) as p95_latency_ms
FROM llm.ai_brain_calls
WHERE ts_ny >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
  AND provider != ''
GROUP BY model, provider
ORDER BY calls DESC

panels.title: 📋 Model Usage Table (模型使用详情)
📈 Session & Input Analysis (会话和输入分析)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    session,
    kind,
    count(*) as calls
FROM llm.ai_brain_calls
WHERE ts_ny >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
  AND session != ''
GROUP BY session, kind
ORDER BY session, kind

panels.title: 📊 Calls by Session (按会话调用量)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    arrayStringConcat(input_keys, ', ') as input_pattern,
    kind,
    count(*) as occurrences,
    round(avg(duration_ms), 1) as avg_latency_ms
FROM llm.ai_brain_calls
WHERE ts_ny >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
  AND length(input_keys) > 0
GROUP BY input_pattern, kind
ORDER BY occurrences DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: 🔑 Input Keys Patterns (输入参数模式)
🌍 Trading Universe Analysis (交易标的分析)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    toStartOfHour(ts_ny) as time,
    avg(trading_universe_count) as avg_universe_size
FROM llm.ai_brain_calls
WHERE ts_ny >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
  AND trading_universe_count > 0
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time
